Getting started with txschools

getting-started.Rmd

txschools makes it straightforward to pull public school-performance data published by the Texas Education Agency (TEA): the Texas Academic Performance Reports (TAPR, 2013-present), the School Report Card (SRC, 2004-2019), and the Academic Excellence Indicator System (AEIS, 2004-2012).

Find your school

TEA identifies campuses by nine-digit county-district-campus numbers and districts by six-digit numbers. Look them up by name:

txs_find_campus("china spring")

Discover available years and downloads 

txs_list_years("tapr")

downloads <- txs_list_downloads(2024, source = "tapr")
downloads

TAPR’s statewide data lives behind TEA’s SAS-broker “Advanced Download” interface: one CSV per level × dataset code ("REF", "STAAR1", "GRAD", …). The TAPR_*.xlsx workbooks TEA links as “TAPR Data in Excel” are variable dictionaries, exposed here as data_type = "dictionary".

Download semantic TAPR datasets 

tapr <- txs_get_tapr(
  year      = 2025,
  level     = "campus",
  geography = "161920102",
  datasets  = c("grade", "sex")
)
tapr$grade

txs_get_tapr() returns a named list because a TAPR report is a collection of datasets, not one rectangular table.

Download a statewide TAPR data file 

df <- txs_get_tapr_file(
  year        = 2024,
  level       = "campus",
  dataset     = "REF",
  data_type   = "advanced",
  output      = "tidy"
)
df

Variable codes are documented in the per-year dictionary:

dict <- txs_get_tapr_dictionary(2024, "campus")
dict

Every call records source metadata as an attribute:

attr(df, "txschools")

A re-call uses the cached copy without re-downloading.

School Report Cards

TEA publishes SRC as per-campus reports. 2004-2012 campus reports are HTML and parse into a tidy tibble; 2013-2019 reports are PDF and are downloaded to the cache:

src <- txs_get_src(2011, "campus", "161920102")
src

AEIS

Statewide AEIS files (2004-2012) are keyed by level and dataset code:

aeis <- txs_get_aeis(2011, "district", dataset = "ref",
                     geography = "161920")
aeis

Citation 

txs_cite(df)

Bulk multi-year downloads 

plan <- txs_bulk_plan(2023:2024, levels = "campus", datasets = c("REF", "GRAD"))
plan
done <- txs_bulk_download(plan, delay = 5)
done
